exposure: hemostatic profile (fibrinogen, factor II, factor V)
cohort: The study included 122 newborns with spontaneous prematurity, a median gestational age of 31 5/7 weeks [29 2/7; 34 0/7] and a median weight of 1145 g [785; 1490].
finding: Only a lower level of factor V (FV) at birth was significantly associated with intraventricular hemorrhage, with an unadjusted OR per SD increase in FV of 0.57 (95%CI, 0.34 to 0.96).
mod_finding: Level of fibrinogen was higher in cases of vaginal delivery.
